CustomField.description: Set by admins. The phone number this user calls from in the Call Anchor app. The Call Anchor webhook matches the call's agentNumber (last 10 digits) against this field to set the owner of the call log Task and the callback follow-up Task.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The agent's mobile number as registered in the Call Anchor app. Calls from this number are logged as Tasks owned by this user.
CustomField.label: Call Anchor Phone
